title: dactylorhiza romana subsp. libanotica
intro: Dactylorhiza romana subsp. libanotica, commonly known as the Syrian orchid, is a plant species that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, that may aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and treating various infections. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza romana subsp. libanotica include its ability to stimulate blood circulation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit diuretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
